Not a real outage - Icinga is checking the wrong address.

- Address Icinga uses: 10.44.18.23 (the pre-move address), not 10.44.30.23.
- Check: hostalive (ICMP ping) - "PING CRITICAL - 10.44.18.23: rta nan, lost 100%".
- DOWN since: 2026-12-02 06:52 UTC, twelve minutes after the VLAN move.
- Duration: 28 hours as of 10:52 UTC today.

The host object was never updated after the move, so Icinga keeps pinging an address nothing answers
on any more. Uploads and SSH working on 10.44.30.23 fit that. Don't raise the P1 with the network
team; update the host's address in the Icinga config to 10.44.30.23 and the check should recover.
(sftp-edge-cph-05 is already on the new VLAN at 10.44.30.24 and is UP.)
